RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel reflects poor diversity governance and increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias, but it does not constitute evidence of discrimination. In banking, "Head of" roles frequently prioritize regulatory diplomacy, supervisory relationships, and executive stakeholder management over technical depth, giving a candidate with broad regulatory experience a legitimate edge.

Raising panel gender without concrete proof will likely be perceived as an accusation, potentially damaging your professional reputation in a niche industry. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on your interviews. Frame your inquiry around how to broaden your regulatory leadership profile for future executive opportunities.
